snippet.title: Touhou ~ Phantom Assembler - Trailer
snippet.description:
A certain brown-haired Touhou university student ventures into a dream world. 
Features: King's Field-like combat and crypticness, a funky aiming mechanic, some bullets, flower eating

Download here: https://noeticnightjar.itch.io/touhou-phantom-assembler

Made for/submitted to Touhou Fan Game Jam 8 (https://itch.io/jam/touhou-jam-8) and Bullet Hell Jam 2022 (https://itch.io/jam/bullet-hell-jam-2022)
